name: Haya Ultra Beauty Cream | Advanced Skin Brightening Solution for All Skin Types 30gm
description:
Haya Ultra Beauty Cream is a premium skincare solution designed to restore your skin’s natural glow and youthful radiance. Enriched with nourishing ingredients, it reduces dullness, lightens dark spots, and evens out skin tone while improving overall texture. Its lightweight, non-greasy formula absorbs quickly, providing lasting hydration without clogging pores. Suitable for all skin types, it can be used daily for a clearer, fresher, and luminous complexion. Packed in a handy 30gm size, it’s perfect for everyday skincare.
Key Features
 Advanced brightening formula enhances natural radiance
 Evens skin tone, reduces dark spots and discoloration
 Lightweight, hydrating, and non-greasy formula
 Safe for all skin types, suitable for daily use
 Compact 30gm pack, ideal for travel and everyday use
How to Use
 Cleanse face thoroughly before application
 Apply a small amount evenly on face and neck
 Massage gently until fully absorbed
 Use daily for best results
Material
Premium skincare ingredients (paraben-free, non-greasy cream)
Safety Information
 For external use only
 Avoid contact with eyes
 Discontinue use if irritation occurs
 Keep out of reach of children
Package Includes
 1 × 30gm Haya Ultra Beauty Cream
